title: Staffing class taxonomy
description: Top-level taxonomy data plus a reusable classBlock definition for manifests and attempt records ($defs/classBlock, referencable as classes.schema.json#/$defs/classBlock). This schema declares exactly the five class value sets (role, oracle_type, domain_tags, size_band, language) and the deterministic don't-cheap-trial rule as inspectable data. Class metadata MUST NOT map directly to a preferred model or route: it may only (1) join production attempts to comparable benchmark evidence and (2) determine whether an unevidenced cheap trial is permitted. Any class-to-model or class-to-route property is forbidden here and is a High finding (D206); no model ids, routes, preferences, selection, or ranking are expressible in this schema. No taxonomy growth is possible: every value set is closed and unknown fields are rejected strictly.

taxonomy_version.description: Stable nonempty identifier for this taxonomy revision.

key_grammar.description: The exact class key grammar, fixed by const so it cannot drift.

canonical_encoding.description: The one canonical encoding for the domain-tags key segment, declared as data.

value_sets.description: Exactly the five class value sets, each closed (enum + exact cardinality). These arrays are the authoritative vocabularies; classBlock enums reference the same members.

cheap_trial_rule.description: The deterministic don't-cheap-trial rule as inspectable data: default allow, two pinned deny conditions, and the supervisor-override-as-attempt-evidence escape, recorded in either direction (it may allow or deny a cheap trial). Contains no model ids, routes, or preferences.

stableRef.description: A stable, nonempty identifier: starts with an alphanumeric character, then alphanumerics, dots, underscores, colons, or hyphens.

canonicalEncoding.description: Canonical encoding of the domain-tags key segment. Tags are sorted ascending by codepoint, deduplicated, and joined by '+', which is unambiguous because no tag value contains '+'. The empty tag set is encoded as the literal string 'none', never as an empty segment (a doubled '/' such as impl/judge//s/python is invalid). Component fields remain authoritative for validation; if JSON Schema cannot express cross-field key equality (exact match of the key to the sorted, deduplicated tag join), enforcing it is loader work, not schema work.

segment_separator.description: The single '/' separates the five key segments.

tag_separator.description: The single '+' joins multiple domain tags inside the third segment; safe because no tag value contains '+'.

tag_order.description: Multiple tags MUST appear in ascending codepoint (byte) order, e.g. persistence+security, never security+persistence.

tag_dedup.description: Multiple tags MUST be deduplicated; a tag may not appear twice in the segment.

empty_tags_segment.description: The empty tag set is encoded as the literal string 'none' in the third key segment; an empty segment (doubled slash) is never emitted.

notes.description: Nonempty prose notes on the encoding, including the statement that component fields are authoritative and cross-field key equality is loader work if JSON Schema cannot express it.

valueSets.description: Exactly the five class value sets. Each array is closed by items enum and exact cardinality; no other values can be added (no taxonomy growth).

domain_tags.description: Exactly the seven domain tag values; the tag set may otherwise be empty in a classBlock.

size_band.description: Exactly the four size band values.

cheapTrialRule.description: The deterministic don't-cheap-trial rule as data. Semantics: start from default; if any deny condition's 'when' holds for a class, the unevidenced cheap trial is denied; a supervisor override, recorded as attempt evidence in either direction, may lift the denial (direction allow_cheap_trial) or impose one (direction deny_cheap_trial). Purely structural data: fields name classBlock components only, never models or routes. The deny_conditions array is pinned positionally: exactly the two declared conditions, in this order, with exact predicates — no additional, reordered, or renamed predicate can validate.

default.description: Classes that match no deny condition permit an unevidenced cheap trial.

deny_conditions.description: Exactly the two deny conditions, ordered and const-pinned: position 0 is reason oracle_human_or_none with when {field: oracle_type, op: in, values: [human, none]}; position 1 is reason risk_tag_on_m_or_l with when {all_of: [{field: size_band, op: in, values: [m, l]}, {field: domain_tags, op: intersects, values: [persistence, concurrency, security, authority]}]}. Positions, reason labels, fields, operators, and value sets (including value order) are all fixed; items:false plus minItems/maxItems 2 forbids additional, reordered, or renamed predicates.

override.description: The only way past a denial: a supervisor override, which is itself recorded as attempt evidence in either direction — it may lift a denial (allow an unevidenced cheap trial) or impose a denial on a class the default would allow. Risk gating only: it names no model, route, provider, or preference.

direction.description: Closed direction enum: the supervisor override, recorded as attempt evidence, either allows a cheap trial (lifting a denial) or denies one (imposing the gate on a class the default would permit). Both directions are equally recorded.

description.description: Nonempty statement of how the override is recorded as attempt evidence and what either direction permits or forbids.

denyOracleHumanOrNone.description: Pinned deny condition at deny_conditions position 0: reason oracle_human_or_none iff field oracle_type, op in, values exactly [human, none]. Every field is const; no other predicate or reason can sit in this position.

values.description: Exactly the two members human and none, in this order.

denyRiskTagOnMOrL.description: Pinned deny condition at deny_conditions position 1: reason risk_tag_on_m_or_l iff when.all_of is exactly the two predicates size_band in [m, l] then domain_tags intersects [persistence, concurrency, security, authority], in this order, with items:false forbidding a third or renamed predicate.

values.description: Exactly m and l, in this order.
Exactly the four risk tags, in this order. ui-browser, data-schema, and infra-env are not risk tags and are forbidden here.

classBlock.description: Reusable class metadata block for manifests and attempt records. All six fields are required and unknown fields are rejected: any class-to-model or class-to-route property (for example preferred_model, model_ref, route, provider) fails here per D206. The five component fields are authoritative for validation; class_key is the canonical string rendering (role/oracle_type/domain_tags/size_band/language with tags sorted ascending by codepoint, deduplicated, '+'-joined, and the empty set rendered as the literal 'none', never an empty segment). Cross-field equality between class_key and the components, plus sortedness/dedup of the key segment beyond what the pattern enforces, is loader work if JSON Schema cannot express it.

class_key.description: Canonical key string: role/oracle_type/domain_tags/size_band/language, with the domain-tags segment the literal 'none' for the empty tag set, or one or more tags from the closed set joined by '+' (sortedness and dedup of the segment are loader-enforced). An empty segment (doubled slash) is rejected.

role.description: Class role; member of the closed role value set.

oracle_type.description: Oracle kind for this class; member of the closed oracle_type value set.

domain_tags.description: Domain tags; the closed seven-tag vocabulary, unique members, possibly empty. This is the authoritative component for the third key segment.

size_band.description: Size band; member of the closed size_band value set.

language.description: Primary language; member of the closed language value set.
